methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNIDO's publications catalog lives at www.unido.org/publications (Drupal), with a companion /publications/catalogue covering ~27,000 documents on a newer search platform. A separate data platform, open.unido.org, was evaluated but it is the COMPASS open-data / projects portal (project and statistical data), not a document repository, so www.unido.org/publications is preferred as the document source per the brief.

## Source selection
RECOMMEND www.unido.org/publications (and /publications/catalogue) over open.unido.org: the former is the actual publications repository with document records and PDFs, whereas open.unido.org exposes project/open-data rather than downloadable publications.

## Search
The /publications/catalogue platform offers contextual search over ~27k documents; a stable query-parameter template for automated search was not verified, so the search capability is not claimed. Browse + facets are available on /publications.

## Filters
Facets (publication type via /publications-type) appear as URL paths/params; treated as opaque params (no formal schema).

## Download
Cards link to record pages that expose the PDF; a two-step crawl is required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title and date are in the HTML. No verified JSON/REST API; enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
HONEST: www.unido.org/publications returned HTTP 403 to the crawler User-Agent (Cloudflare/WAF), not because it is a JS SPA. It is server-rendered and scrapable with a realistic browser User-Agent. The newer catalogue's search API/params were not verified, so search is not claimed. open.unido.org is out of scope (open-data, not publications).
